name: @vrmxg/cast
description: VRMXG casting (M4 W6): the roles a script gives a sequence, each cast from a .vrmxa (read through vrmxa-core, injected), its voice (a persona's Kokoro preset, else a role → preset map) and allowed expressions from the persona, its wardrobe through the closet; recasting that swaps the character, keeps the role's performance byte for byte and lists its lines to re-bake in the new voice; each cast one undoable edit; deterministic output.
